prompt: {"task":{"problem":"Design check (not a formal proof): verify a small UI/API design for the Arachne resource panel against loom's actual API surface, so that the claims below are either confirmed or corrected against the loom source. (3) Does the existing fleet SSE subscription see issue_added/issue_closed events so the panel can live-refresh? BranchSummaryView.github is a PR snapshot maintained by loom's poll loop, present in sessions/summary/list output. C. issue_added/closed/reopened SSE events are recorded on the claiming branch's topic, and Arachne's fleet poller subscribes to session:<id> topics whose any event triggers a fleet re-snapshot, so new issues appear without new plumbing. D. An issue claimed by a branch name matches at most the sessions in the topic subtree sharing that branch name, so scoping issues to a topic = filtering board output by (repo_root of topic) ∪ (claimed_branch ∈ branch names of topic subtree). E.
